text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy for prompt-mux-v2 started (10% traffic) — automated alerts: increase in 5xx on /v1/prompt-route. Triggering this thread.

alex: seeing 500s across multiple zones, modelproxy timeouts in logs (timeout: 30s).
rachel: paging oncall @mike-sre — this looks like the new endpoint that just rolled.
pagerduty: Paging mike-sre: Incident INC-20260315-042. Please acknowledge with `/ack`. Priority: P1.
mike-sre: acked. Taking oncall. Can we freeze the canary and get a quick snapshot of top errors? @deploy-bot, can you hold further rollout?
deploy-bot: Hold engaged. No additional hosts will be promoted. FF "mux_v2_canary" currently ON for 10%. To immediately eject canary traffic, toggle FF off or run:
```bash
redwood-ffctl set mux_v2_canary false --env prod
```
mike-sre: running kill now — flipping ff. Expected propagation ~15-45s. Routing fallback -> prompt-mux-v1.
deploy-bot: Feature flag flip received from mike-sre. New state: mux_v2_canary = OFF. All canary traffic diverted back to v1. Telemetry: 5xx rate dropping, latency trending to baseline (~40s).
rachel: nice. @cs-ops can you pull top impacted orgs in the last 10m and DM them? We should notify any paid customers impacted.
cs-ops: on it — pulling list. Quick summary: org-eta (500s 72%), org-zen (500s 64%), org-pine (500s 11%) — contacting org-eta & org-zen now with brief note and mitigation steps. Will update thread.
cs-ops: sending DM templates: "We're seeing elevated 500s on prompt routing affecting some requests. We've rolled traffic back to the stable route and are monitoring. No action required from your side; we'll follow up with a postmortem."
sre-manager: good call on fast eject. Marking release as blocked until root cause triaged. Please create incident channel `#incident-muxflip-1769009999` and start timeline.
incident-bot: Created incident channel #incident-muxflip-1769009999 and notified Eng leadership + Product. Pagerduty incident updated with timeline entry (kill at +00:03).
mike-sre: handing session to gabi for next 2h (meeting). gabi, can you pick up monitoring and customer follow-ups?
gabi: on it — monitoring dashboards up, alert thresholds lowered to catch regressions. I'll follow-up with a brief RCA stub once we have log sampling and proxy traces.
alex: keeping a copy of relevant modelproxy traces and a sample request/response for root cause. Will attach to incident channel.
rachel: update: customers notified, support tickets opened for org-eta & org-zen, CS lead assigned.
sre-manager: thanks everyone. Postmortem required, include timeline, FF decision points, mitigations, and a checklist to tighten canary health checks.
cs-ops: will close customer comms loop once we have RCA.
mike-sre: leaving oncall to gabi. If errors resurge, re-open this thread and escalate.
gabi: acknowledged.
